entities.summary: Yulia Merkulova is a Russian volleyball player, who was born in Lipetsk. Standing at 202 cm, she plays as a middle blocker. She was part of the Russia women's national volleyball team at the 2006 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Championship in Japan. At club level, she plays for Dinamo Krasnodar.
